title: docs(objectql, runtime): qualify "still holds under another owner spelling" in the released #32877 CHANGELOG entries
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDwkEEJd65kqFZGFjQnzBQt)_

Refs #32910 (D2-N2 wording; the pins land in #33439)

Area-lease pilot #33059 · area E2b · seat `domain:server#5` · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cz4f7zEQZ2C9GTG382

## What changes

The released 18.4.0 entries for PR #32877 (a re-bind takes the old owner's bare-name claim off with the function) in `packages/objectql/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/runtime/CHANGELOG.md` say:

> So a name the package still holds under another owner spelling (its bare id) keeps its claim …

Both now read:

> So a name the package still holds **in the engine's holder set** under another owner spelling (its bare id) keeps its claim …

Docs-only. No code, no test, no changeset.

## Why

#32910 D2-N2 (epic red-line delta read 6840550973): whether the package "still holds" the name is read from the engine's holder set, and with the two owner spellings registered in the other order the shared holder entry is replaced first and the claim is (correctly) freed. #32910 asked to qualify the changeset-level wording; that changeset has been consumed by the 18.4.0 release, so per AGENTS.md (RELEASE-OWNED, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md`) the released entries are amended in a dedicated docs-only PR.

## Verification

- `git diff origin/main` — two lines, the same five-word insertion in each entry.
- `git grep "another owner spelling" origin/main` finds only these two entries.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
